item.title: Shosenkyo Gorge: One of Japan's Most Beautiful Ravines — Guide
item.description: Shosenkyo Gorge, near Kofu, is often ranked among Japan’s most beautiful gorges, offering a scenic walking trail that follows a clear river past towering granite rock formations, sculpted cliffs and the striking Sengataki Waterfall at its upper end. The gorge is especially renowned for its autumn foliage, when the mix of coloured maples against the pale granite draws large crowds, and a ropeway near the top offers panoramic views extending to Mount Fuji and the Southern Alps on clear days.
